build.template: Run `xcodebuild build -scheme <YOUR-SCHEME> -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath DerivedData` and report ERRORS only. NEVER run in parallel with another xcodebuild.

test.template: Run xcodebuild test for the scheme $ARGUMENTS, -derivedDataPath DerivedData -parallel-testing-enabled NO. Summarize failures only. NEVER run in parallel with another xcodebuild.

lint.template: Run `swiftlint lint --quiet $ARGUMENTS` from the repo root. If $ARGUMENTS is empty, lint all staged .swift files.

sim-shot.template: Run `scripts/sim.sh shot $ARGUMENTS` and inspect the screenshots.
